title: Microsoft Agent Framework Releases Poisoned With Credential Stealer
description: Two malicious versions (1.26.1 and 1.26.2) of the Microsoft Agent Framework Python package on PyPI were released in a supply chain attack. These versions steal Azure, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions credentials by executing code automatically when Python starts, even if the package is not explicitly imported. The malicious packages retained legitimate functionality while adding credential-stealing code. The compromised versions have been removed from PyPI, and the latest clean release is 1.26.0. Organizations are advised to check for these versions, replace them with verified packages, rotate exposed credentials, and investigate suspicious activity.
